status: implemented; native-source review and gofmt only; no build or runtime test by this agent
scope: Explicit synchronous zero-delay reuse of one native AttackEvent inside ordinary ability invocation/producer scope. Delayed or arbitrary event/entity scope reuse is not claimed.
changes: BeginImmediateAttackOccurrence saves, clears and restores only SourceHostOrigin, SourceHostQueuedObservationIndex, SourceHostAttackID and SourceHostDispatchID.
Core wrapper calls the existing QueueAttackEvent(ae, 0) exactly once on the same native pointer.
Existing CaptureAttack, PrepareAttack and BeginAttackDispatch allocate independent queue/attack/dispatch identities for each explicit occurrence.
Ability invocation and ability producer finalizers resolve AttackID through their immutable queued row QueueID into the queued AttackObservation, not from a reused pointer later.
Native Info, Snapshot, Pattern, SourceFrame, Callbacks and reaction fields are neither copied nor restored. Existing gameplay mutations remain on the native reused object.

evidence: pkg/core/attack.go: QueueAttackEvent calls CaptureAttack then queueDmg; queueDmg delay 0 calls Combat.ApplyAttack synchronously.

pkg/core/combat/attack.go: native per-target attack already performs cpy := *a before HandleAttack; the later enemy application and hit callback tasks retain this occurrence identity on that native per-target copy.
internal/characters/kirara/skill.go: short/long hold mutates the existing d.Pattern, then QueueAttackEvent(d,0); long hold reuses d across core tasks.

OnApplyAttack listeners reviewed: Xianyun only plunge path; Flins and Columbina only lunar tags; Stellar Odette only stellar tags. No matching Kirara hold path retains the original pointer for delayed work.

limitations: No new support for delayed reuse of one AttackEvent, where concurrent pending queues would need explicit occurrence state through task execution.
Other event/entity/hit/shield reference finalizers remain unchanged; this explicit helper is used only within audited ordinary ability scope.
